1password.workflow: finding an item and locking your vault when you step away
1password.tip: Try Search first with 1Password open. Keep vault actions on a page you can reach easily when you’re signing in to an app.

adobe-acrobat-reader.workflow: finding your way around long PDFs
adobe-acrobat-reader.tip: Use Find to enter a term, then tap Next Match to move through the same results without reopening the search field.

adobe-illustrator.workflow: saving versions of illustrations and exporting artwork
adobe-illustrator.tip: Put Save Copy next to Web Export so you can keep a working copy of an illustration and export a separate version for sharing.

adobe-lightroom.workflow: checking composition and detail while editing photos
adobe-lightroom.tip: Keep Zoom In and Zoom Out together to switch between close inspection and the overall composition. Open a photo before trying Rotate Left.

adobe-photoshop.tip: Select the layer you want to work on first. Free Transform is a useful first test because Photoshop shows a transform box when the command applies.

adobe-premiere-pro.workflow: setting up a video edit and preparing it for export
adobe-premiere-pro.tip: Try New Sequence with a project open. Keep Export Media separate from the shortcuts you tap repeatedly during an edit.

affinity-designer.workflow: starting design files and working with pixel layers
affinity-designer.tip: Add Pixel Layer beside Next View if you work with several documents. Open a design before trying the layer command.

affinity-photo.workflow: opening images and keeping layer edits organised
affinity-photo.tip: Try New Layer with an image open. Keep Save on the same page so incremental edits are easy to save as you work.

affinity-publisher.workflow: starting publications and finding text in long layouts
affinity-publisher.tip: Use Find for a word in an open publication and Next View when you have more than one view to switch between.

alfred.workflow: opening Alfred and sending search results to Finder
alfred.tip: Open Alfred and highlight a file result before trying Reveal File. These button presses follow the shortcuts configured in Alfred.

arc.workflow: managing tabs and reaching the Arc sidebar
arc.tip: Try Toggle Sidebar in an Arc window. Use Pin Tab on a tab you want to keep in the current space.

athena.workflow: starting chats and finding work in Athena
athena.tip: Put Search Chats next to New Chat so you can choose between returning to an existing conversation and starting a new one.

audacity.workflow: marking edit points in a recording
audacity.tip: Try Add Label with the playhead at a point you want to revisit. Previous Label is useful once the project has labels to navigate.

bambu-studio.workflow: preparing a print plate from a 3D model
bambu-studio.tip: Import a model and check its position on the plate before slicing. A separate Save Project button helps you keep the plate setup for later.

bear.workflow: formatting notes and making quick checklists
bear.tip: Put the cursor in a note before using the formatting buttons. New To-do is handy for turning a meeting note into a short action list.

books.workflow: turning pages and marking places while reading Apple Books
books.tip: Open an ebook first and put Next Page and Previous Page side by side. Keep Bookmark Page nearby for passages you want to return to.

brave-browser.workflow: opening pages and recovering tabs in Brave
brave-browser.tip: Try New Tab in an open Brave window, then use Search Tabs when several pages are open. Reopen Closed Tab is useful after closing a page by mistake.

calendar.workflow: jumping between today and different Calendar views
calendar.tip: Put Today next to Week View to get back to your current schedule after browsing another date.

chatgpt-classic.workflow: starting and finding conversations in ChatGPT Classic
chatgpt-classic.tip: Try the presets with ChatGPT Classic open. Select the matching ChatGPT entry in EspDesktop if you have more than one version installed.

chatgpt-desktop.workflow: working across chats and tabs in ChatGPT Desktop
chatgpt-desktop.tip: Use Next Tab after opening more than one chat tab. Pick the ChatGPT Desktop preset group that matches the Mac app you use.

claude-desktop.workflow: starting and finding sessions in Claude Desktop
claude-desktop.tip: Keep Session Search close to New Session if you regularly return to earlier work. Try the shortcut in the Claude view where you normally use it.

cursor.workflow: editing code and opening common commands in Cursor
cursor.tip: Select a few lines in an open file before trying Inline Edit. Command Palette makes a good fallback for actions you rarely use.

davinci-resolve.workflow: saving edits and stepping through changes in DaVinci Resolve
davinci-resolve.tip: Try the buttons in a scratch project. Keeping Undo and Redo next to each other makes it easy to step back and reapply an edit.

discord.workflow: moving between channels and controlling a Discord call
discord.tip: Try Quick Switch in the Discord window. Test Toggle Mic in a private call and check Discord’s mic indicator before relying on it.

evernote.workflow: capturing a note and finding it later
evernote.tip: Put New Note beside Search Notes for a quick capture-and-retrieve pair. Open your notebook first if you want to check where a new note goes.

facetime.workflow: changing the video view during a FaceTime call
facetime.tip: Try the view controls with a video window open. Full Screen is a simple first test before arranging your other call controls.

final-cut-pro.workflow: organising clips and building a Final Cut Pro timeline
final-cut-pro.tip: Select clips in the timeline before trying Compound Clip or New Storyline. Use Reveal Media when you need to locate a clip’s source.

finder.workflow: opening folders and finding files in Finder
finder.tip: Tap Go to Folder to open Finder’s path field, then enter or paste a folder path on your Mac.

firefox.workflow: searching pages and reloading them while browsing
firefox.tip: Test Find Text on a page with visible text and keep Force Reload handy for when a standard refresh leaves old content in place.

freeform.workflow: starting boards and making copies to explore ideas
freeform.tip: Open or select a board before trying Duplicate Board. Use the copy to explore a different layout while retaining the original.

garageband.workflow: splitting and joining regions while arranging audio
garageband.tip: Select a region and move the playhead to the intended cut before using Split Playhead. Try it in a project you can safely experiment with.

github-desktop.workflow: checking repository changes and reviewing commit history
github-desktop.tip: Try View Changes with a repository open, then use Commit History to compare current edits with work already committed.

gitkraken.workflow: finding commits and starting branches in GitKraken
gitkraken.tip: Open a repository first. Try Search Commits, then use File History where you would normally inspect how a file has changed.

google-chrome.workflow: finding text and opening browsing windows in Chrome
google-chrome.tip: Open a page and use Find Text to search within it. Keep Incognito separate if you often switch between regular and private browsing.

google-meet.workflow: controlling your microphone, camera and meeting panels
google-meet.tip: Install Google Meet as a web app in Safari or Chrome and approve it in EspDesktop. Join a meeting in that app, then try Toggle Microphone and check the microphone icon in Meet.

hermes.workflow: opening and finding work sessions in Hermes
hermes.tip: Keep Search Sessions next to New Session. Try Command Palette with the Hermes window active to check that the integration is sending keys to the expected app.

iina.workflow: changing video playback speed and returning to normal
iina.tip: Try the speed buttons with a video playing. Put Reset Speed next to Faster and Slower so you can return to the original playback speed in one tap.

imovie.workflow: starting a movie and viewing it full screen in iMovie
imovie.tip: Use New Movie when you’re ready to start an edit, then try Full Screen with a movie or viewer open.

iterm2.workflow: arranging terminal panes and searching output
iterm2.tip: Try the split controls in an open terminal window. A Find Text button is useful when you need to locate a command or error in existing output.

keynote.workflow: working with slide layouts and finding text in a deck
keynote.tip: Open a presentation before trying these buttons. Select something on a slide if you want New Comment attached to a specific item.

logic-pro.workflow: marking sections and grouping tracks in Logic Pro
logic-pro.tip: Try Add Marker at a useful playback position. Select the relevant tracks before using Group Tracks.

mail.workflow: starting emails and clearing messages from your inbox
mail.tip: Try Reply and Archive with a message selected. Put Archive away from New Email if you want to keep organisation and writing actions distinct.

mail-plus-for-gmail.workflow: adding links and sending messages in Mail Plus for Gmail
mail-plus-for-gmail.tip: Try Insert Link with a draft open and some text selected. Use a test draft addressed to yourself to check the Send shortcut.

maps.workflow: switching between map views in Apple Maps
maps.tip: Open Maps on your Mac, then try switching from Explore to Transit to see the same area with public transport information.

messages.workflow: starting messages and finding conversations in Apple Messages
messages.tip: Keep Search Chats beside New Message. Try Next Chat with several conversations visible to check how the Mac app moves through them.

microsoft-excel.workflow: starting workbooks and organising spreadsheet data
microsoft-excel.tip: Try Find in an open workbook. For New Table, select the range you want to turn into a table before tapping the shortcut.

microsoft-outlook.workflow: composing email and searching your Outlook folders
microsoft-outlook.tip: Use Search Folder when you know where a message is likely to be. Advanced Search is useful when you need more ways to narrow the results.

microsoft-powerpoint.workflow: building slides and rehearsing a presentation
microsoft-powerpoint.tip: Select a slide before tapping Duplicate Slide. Try Play Here when you want to test a section without starting the presentation from the beginning.

microsoft-teams.workflow: finding chats and starting messages in Teams
microsoft-teams.tip: Open Teams to check Search first. Use Popout Chat with a chat selected when you want that conversation in its own window.

microsoft-word.workflow: working through text edits and formatting in Word
microsoft-word.tip: Use Find first to check the text you want to change. Select the paragraph you want to format before trying Hanging Indent.

music.workflow: finding music and creating playlists in Apple Music
music.tip: Select songs in your library before using Playlist Selection. Use New Playlist if you want to start with an empty playlist.

notes.workflow: capturing ideas and turning them into checklists in Apple Notes
notes.tip: Try New Note first, then place the cursor in the note before tapping Checklist. Search Notes helps you get back to notes later.

notion.workflow: finding information and jumping between Notion pages
notion.tip: Use Find Text for the page you’re already on and Jump Page to navigate elsewhere. Copy URL is useful when you want to share the current page.

numbers.workflow: adding sheets and reviewing spreadsheet content in Numbers
numbers.tip: Try New Sheet in a Numbers document. Select a cell before using New Comment if you want the comment attached to that data.

obs-studio.workflow: editing source layouts in OBS Studio
obs-studio.tip: Select a source in a scratch scene before using Copy Source or Edit Transform. These presets send editor shortcuts to OBS Studio.

obsidian.workflow: opening notes and searching an Obsidian vault
obsidian.tip: Use Quick Switch when you know a note’s name, Search Vault when you know some of its text, and Toggle Reading to check how the current note looks.

opencode.workflow: opening coding sessions and reviewing changes in OpenCode
opencode.tip: Use Find Files when you know what you want to open and Review Changes when you want to inspect the current workspace edits.

orcaslicer.workflow: importing models and preparing print plates in OrcaSlicer
orcaslicer.tip: Start with a model on the plate before using Slice Plate. Put Export Slice nearby if you regularly save the resulting print file.

pages.workflow: starting documents and working through editorial edits in Pages
pages.tip: Highlight the text you want to discuss before tapping New Comment. Use Find to revisit a particular word in a long document.

photos.workflow: finding photos and organising them in albums
photos.tip: Try Search Photos from your library. Use New Album for a photo collection and New Folder when you want to group albums.

pixelmator-pro.workflow: organising image layers and preparing exports
pixelmator-pro.tip: Open an image, then try Fit Image to bring the full canvas into view. Keep Export Image nearby for when the edit is ready to share.

podcasts.workflow: finding shows and managing feeds in Apple Podcasts
podcasts.tip: Start with Search Podcasts to find something to listen to. Use New Station if you want to group shows you return to regularly.

preview.workflow: switching between tabs and documents in Preview
preview.tip: Open multiple PDFs or images before testing these controls. Next Tab is useful inside one window and Next Document when working across separate documents.

quicktime-player.workflow: opening recording controls from your desk
quicktime-player.tip: Choose the recording type on the touchscreen, then check the QuickTime controls on your Mac for the input or screen area.

raycast.workflow: opening Raycast search and reaching an item’s actions
raycast.tip: Try Toggle Raycast to bring up the launcher. Highlight a result before tapping Actions to see what Raycast can do with it.

reminders.workflow: capturing tasks and organising lists in Apple Reminders
reminders.tip: Select a reminder before using Toggle Complete. Keep New Reminder next to it if you use the display to work through a task list.

safari.workflow: opening tabs and finding content in Safari
safari.tip: Use Tab Overview when you want to see open Safari tabs together and Find Text when you know what to look for on the current page.

safari-web-app.workflow: navigating a website installed as a Mac app
safari-web-app.tip: Open the site from the Dock before trying the shortcuts. Main Page is useful when you want to jump back to the web app’s start page.

signal.workflow: jumping to conversations and searching messages in Signal
signal.tip: Select the conversation before tapping Search Chat or Focus Composer so the action applies to the thread you intend to use.

sketch.workflow: working with design pages and sharing links in Sketch
sketch.tip: Open a Sketch document before tapping New Page. Use Zoom Out to review how a design is laid out across the canvas.

slack.workflow: starting messages and finding conversations in Slack
slack.tip: Use Quick Switch to jump to another channel or person. Search chat helps you find something in the conversation already open.

spotify.workflow: finding music and getting back to what’s playing
spotify.tip: Use Search to find a track or artist. Keep Now Playing nearby when you want to return to playback information while browsing playlists.

streamlabs-desktop.workflow: preparing a streaming layout and getting to common editor commands
streamlabs-desktop.tip: With a test scene open, select a webcam or overlay source before tapping a nudge shortcut. Open Settings is a simple first test when Streamlabs Desktop is open.

telegram.workflow: searching messages and moving between Telegram chats
telegram.tip: Use Search Chat for a detail in the current thread and Search All when you aren’t sure which chat contains the message.

things-3.workflow: capturing tasks and organising them into projects
things-3.tip: Put New To-do and Quick Entry next to each other if you capture tasks both inside Things and while working elsewhere.

todoist.workflow: capturing tasks and finding Todoist projects
todoist.tip: Use Add Task to capture an item, then tap Inbox to go back to your unorganised tasks. Quick Find is handy when you know a project name.

transmit.workflow: refreshing a remote file list and checking transfers
transmit.tip: Connect to a server before trying Refresh in a remote folder. Keep Transfers nearby to check how uploads and downloads are progressing.

tv.workflow: organising videos and refreshing playlists in the Apple TV app
tv.tip: Try Import Video with a video file you have on your Mac. Playlist controls are useful when you manage items in your local library.

twitch.workflow: muting a Twitch stream, changing the player view and saving clips
twitch.tip: In Safari, open twitch.tv and choose File → Add to Dock. Open the installed Twitch web app, click the player, and try Mute / Unmute. Seeking requires a recording or a player with a seek bar. Clip Live Stream depends on whether the channel allows clips.

visual-studio-code.workflow: finding files and running editing commands in Visual Studio Code
visual-studio-code.tip: Try Quick Open in a workspace, then type a file name. Keep Save All close by if you tend to edit several files at once.

vlc.workflow: switching between windowed and full-screen playback in VLC
vlc.tip: Start playing a video in VLC and tap Full Screen. The same shortcut lets you return to the windowed player.

warp.workflow: searching terminal commands and opening new tabs in Warp
warp.tip: Try Command Search in a Warp window, then tap Focus Input to return to the prompt when you’re ready to type.

whatsapp.workflow: organising WhatsApp conversations and starting new messages
whatsapp.tip: Use Mark Unread on a conversation you want to return to. Select a chat first before tapping Mute Chat so it applies to the right conversation.

windows-app.workflow: opening remote connections and managing session windows from a Mac
windows-app.tip: Try PC Quick Connect from the Connection Centre. Select a saved PC before tapping Connect to Selected PC, or bring an active remote session forward before trying Fit to Window.

xcode.workflow: building, running and testing projects from the touchscreen
xcode.tip: Open a project and select the scheme you want to use in Xcode before tapping Build or Test. Keep Run next to them for the normal build-and-run workflow.

zoom.workflow: reaching meeting actions such as joining and toggling video
zoom.tip: Try Toggle Video in a private test meeting and check Zoom’s camera indicator. Pause Share applies while you are already sharing your screen.
